name: INFY
verdict: Management exhibits reasonable operational control over operating margins and free cash flow generation, maintaining stability within guided bands despite headwinds. However, their credibility on top-line guidance is strained by sequential downward revisions caused by softer volumes, misjudged pricing realization, and unbudgeted client program cancellations.

trackedPromises.note: Management reduced full-year revenue growth guidance in Oct 2026 due to softer volumes and unmaterialized pricing expansion.
Operating margin targets were successfully maintained at 20%-22% despite wage, acquisition, and AI investment headwinds.
Management consistently reiterated full-year tax rate guidance of 29% to 30% across all quarterly updates.

trail.value: Delivered 3.1% in constant currency, within upgraded guidance band

trackedPromises.note: Full year FY26 revenue reached $20,158 million (3.1% CC growth), delivering within the upgraded guidance set in Jan.
